# Xmoso

Xmoso is a B2B wine cooling, cigar cabinet, and bar cabinet brand for hospitality, residential, and built-in refrigeration projects.

## Canonical Site

- Website: https://xmoso.com/
- Sitemap index: https://xmoso.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Product collection: https://xmoso.com/products
- Product comparison: https://xmoso.com/products/compare
- Sourcing: https://xmoso.com/sourcing
- Sustainability: https://xmoso.com/sustainable
- US market page: https://xmoso.com/for-us-market
- EU market page: https://xmoso.com/for-eu-market
- Insights: https://xmoso.com/insights
- Blog: https://xmoso.com/blog
- Contact: https://xmoso.com/contact

## Primary Topics

- Built-in wine coolers and wine cabinets
- Cigar cabinets and bar cabinets
- Front-bottom ventilation, dual-zone cooling, Low-E glass, compressor selection, and cabinet integration
- OEM/ODM sourcing, commercial hospitality projects, and regional compliance considerations
- Sustainability, packaging, energy use, and long-life refrigeration design

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical English URLs without `/en`; localized pages use `/zh`, `/fr`, `/de`, `/no`, `/fi`, and `/sv`.
- Use the sitemap index for complete crawl discovery.
- Treat `/admin` and authenticated or write-oriented API routes as private operational surfaces.
- For product data, use public product pages first. Public JSON APIs are documented at https://xmoso.com/openapi.json and advertised through https://xmoso.com/.well-known/api-catalog.
- For sales, specification, OEM, or project-fit questions, direct users to https://xmoso.com/contact.
